notes.title: Update 1.2 is Out Now!!!
notes.content:
[b]Attention Shoppers![/b]

We have another major content update for you! This update adds a new game mode to multiplayer: [b]Prop Hunt[/b]

[b]-------------------------------[/b]
This new multiplayer mode splits players into two teams:

   [b]-Shoppers:[/b]
Make it to checkout without going over budget AND not putting any Prop players in your cart 
OR
Destroy all the Prop players just like you would with normal items

   [b]-Props:[/b]
Get a shopper to pick you up and put you in their cart without getting caught!
[b]-------------------------------[/b]

This mode is available to all who have unlocked Multiplayer (by checking out on level 1 "Grocery Store" on any difficulty)

Thank you all and Happy Shopping!

notes.title: Update 1.1 is out Now!!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42848145/ebdf55b773c8af7c6a04881933087203de3c565f.png[/img]

[b]Attention Shoppers![/b]

We have a major update for you! This update adds a new level to both single player and multiplayer titled "Supermarket".

In the spirit of Black Friday, this level takes place in a holiday-themed superstore, and everyone is rushing around to get the best deals. Don't stand still for too long!

This level will only be available in single player after you have successfully checked out on level 6 "Moon".

Thank you all and Happy Shopping!

notes.title: An Update on Playtesting
notes.content:
Attention Shoppers!

The playtest that was originally scheduled for February 18-24, 2023 is being moved to March 4-10, 2023.

This playtest will be our first demo of multiplayer, and we want to make sure that everyone playing has a fun experience. The next upcoming playtest on January 21, 2023 will happen as originally planned.

As always, if you want to get involved with our early-build playtests, all you have to do is join our [url=https://discord.gg/FUDcKR7TdH]Discord[/url]. It's totally free!

Happy Shopping!
Fried Squid Games LLC

notes.title: The Start of Our Journey!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42848145/d045d37d92b1ffba307a7b56b5008e8a95d7ab6f.png[/img]

[b]Attention Shoppers![/b]

We at Fried Squid Games are so excited to get the community involved with our game "Shopping Spree: Extreme!!!"

It is our goal to be as transparent as possible with the development process and keep you all informed about what's happening as we go! Currently, we're planning to release this game in Mid 2023, and we will try our best to meet our deadlines. A full roadmap will be coming soon!

In the meantime, we need your help to spread the word! You can do so in one or more of the following ways:

[list]
[*]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/FUDcKR7TdH]Discord Server[/url]. This will be the main hub for our game during development and members will get access to early-build playtests! 
[*]Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SSE_Game]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/shoppingspreeextreme/]Instagram[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@sse_game]TikTok[/url]
[*]Subscribe to our [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCzXKYNsgsglackVnEPsPUCw]YouTube Channel[/url] and share our teaser trailer with your friends!
[/list]

Thank you all for your support!
